en.description: In three and a half years, we grew this network from 2,000 to 26,000 active agents and from 300 to 18,000 accepting merchants, creating more than 53,000 points of convergence along the way.

page.headline: From 2,000 to 26,000 active agents in three and a half years.
page.intro: We grew this Mobile Money network from 2,000 to 26,000 active agents and from 300 to 18,000 accepting merchants, creating more than 53,000 points of convergence.
page.manifesto: Going from 2,000 to 26,000 agents does not happen by chance: it takes a method, teams and relentless follow-up.

challenge.title: Scaling up without losing control.
paragraphs: Growing a network of agents and merchants means multiplying contact points while keeping execution quality.
The challenge: going from a few thousand agents to several tens of thousands, over time.

approach.title: Recruit, animate, measure.
paragraphs: We deployed and animated the network of agents and merchants with local teams trained and supervised directly.
Every step is tracked by indicators: active agents, accepting merchants, points of convergence.
